intro: No mystery, no black box. Here's the whole process before you commit to anything.

steps.title: You tell me the problem
steps.text: In your words. No technical vocabulary required — that's my job, not yours.

steps.title: I scope it honestly
steps.text: A fixed price and timeline — including telling you if you don't actually need me.

steps.title: You see it every week
steps.text: Something working in your hands each week, so nothing is a surprise at the end.

steps.title: You own it
steps.text: Code, accounts and documentation handed over. No lock-in, no hostage situation.
